title: Prisma Basics
description: Introduction to Prisma ORM, comparison with other ORMs, and setting up Prisma in a Next.js project.
longDescription: This module introduces Prisma as a next-generation ORM for Node.js and TypeScript. You will learn what Prisma is, how it compares to other ORMs like TypeORM and Drizzle, how to install it in both Next.js App Router and Pages Router projects, and how to set up Prisma Client for the first time.
whatYouLearn: Understand what Prisma is and its role as a database toolkit
Compare Prisma with other ORMs like TypeORM, Sequelize, and Drizzle
Install Prisma in Next.js App Router and Pages Router projects
Configure Prisma Client for your application
Use Prisma Studio for database exploration
